title: Growing our own dependence
summary: EDITORIAL: Pakistan’s cotton crop is facing another projected decline, with potentially serious consequences for an economy whose principal merchandise export industry remains heavily dependent on the fibre. The World Bank expects domestic cotton production to fall by 6 percent in 2026-27, against a 3 percent decline in global output. India and Brazil, meanwhile, are projected to increase production by about 1 percent each. These figures should prompt an urgent examination of the government’s agricultural priorities, particularly given the mounting international pressures on commodity markets.

title: गृहमंत्री शाह ने ₹600 करोड़ के म्यूजियम का लोकार्पण किया:रैली में कहा- हरियाणा खेलों मे टॉप; करनाल में कहा- राहुल अराजकता फैला रहे
